utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's for the community center computer, Oren. Trying to get it working again.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, the computer! Right, I remember now. So we're fixing that old thing, huh?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it's been down for a while. I'm hoping we can get it sorted this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Check my garage signup list if you need details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo! I'll take a look at your list. And just to update you, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday works. I'll update the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about it—Saturday, right? I can probably swing by for a bit to help with the fences.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, we're moving it to next Saturday to avoid the school bake sale. Can you still make it then?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Next Saturday? Sure, that should work. Just let me know the time and I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Cleo, I'm glad to hear you're helping out. I've got a spare set of wrenches if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, that's perfect, Gus! We could definitely use those wrenches—I was worried we'd be short on the larger sizes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll bring 'em by tomorrow morning. You setting up in the community center or somewhere else?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I've got some tools in my garage if that helps, Rey.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Eli, great! Let's coordinate — the drive got moved to Sunday at the community center, so we can drop them off there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday, you say? That throws off my schedule a bit, but I can still bring the tools by Saturday afternoon if you want to arrange a drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive at the community center? They're collecting old tools—I just checked with Cleo about screwdrivers, and it sounds like we're in good shape!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, good, so the location is definitely set for Sunday at the community center? I just want to make sure we're all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, Sunday at the community center—that's what I've heard from Cleo too. Should be a great turnout!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We're meeting at the main entrance at 9 AM. Bring your tools if you have them!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, I thought it was at the community center parking lot? Did the location change?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh no, sorry for the mix-up! It's definitely the community center parking lot—I think I got ahead of myself saying main entrance.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, the repair drive – is that the one with the potluck or the bake sale? I always mix those up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No, it's not for an event – it's the USB drive for fixing the community center computer. I'm double-checking the driver version on it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the computer drive! Sorry, I was thinking of something else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Sam, I heard about the repair drive. I've got some tools in my garage if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That'd be great, Rey! I heard it's this Saturday at the community center. I'm sure they'll appreciate any tools you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday sounds good. I'll bring my tool kit over in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I was just telling Eli about it—we're gonna get everyone fixing up the park benches this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds great, Vik! Sorry I'm late to the convo, but I've got some tools ready to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Awesome, Dane! We're all meeting at the park at 10 AM on Saturday to fix those benches!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Jules, thanks for offering to help spread the word! I'm hoping we get a good turnout to fix up the community center computer.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I'll make sure everyone on Maple and Elm knows—do you need any tools or extra hands for the computer fix?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That would be great! I think we could use a few more soldering irons and maybe someone who's good with software.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard from Joe that the leak might be okay now, but I never actually saw it myself.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, you're working on that repair drive? Is it for the community center computer?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I think that's what Joe said—it's for the community center's old computer.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the park benches—it'd be great to have you join!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Who told you that? I haven't said anything about it yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, sorry, I must've mixed things up! I heard about it from someone else—I think it's just a neighborhood thing. Have you seen the flyers around?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I have some tools in my garage you could borrow. Might help with the space issue too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's very kind, Rey, but I'm anxious about moving things around—we just switched the drive to Sunday at the community center, and I've barely figured out the setup there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries, Pia. If you need an extra hand setting up Sunday, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Bo, Quinn told me about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center. You planning on joining?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I think so—Rosa roped me into fixing some fences and porches. Should be a good crew.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, Bo! I've got some spare tools if anyone needs to borrow them. Just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive? I hadn't heard about that—can you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it's a community thing—we're fixing up fences and sheds this weekend. I'm just checking we've got enough supplies like duct tape and nails.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds like a great idea! I'd love to help out if you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... could you remind me what we're fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, we're sprucing up the community center—painting, fixing shelves, that sort of thing. It should be a fun morning with everyone chipping in!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Faye! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center parking lot. Are you planning to come?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, Opal, good news — we actually moved it to next Saturday to avoid the school bake sale. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Ah, thanks for the heads-up, Faye! I'll mark my calendar for next Saturday instead. I don't want to miss helping out with that desktop repair.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything about the repair drive setup?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, honestly Dane, I'm a little fuzzy on it too. I think it's for the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that's what I thought too—community center benches, Saturday. Sorry I'm late, I just grabbed some extra tools from my shed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there whenever it starts. Just let me know the time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Uli, we're planning the repair drive next Saturday—I think Eli and Jules are both excited about it too!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good to hear. What time are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey, Ira, I've got some spare wrenches and screwdrivers if you need 'em for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, Gus, that's perfect! Jules already offered to spread the word, and with your tools, we'll be set to fix up the community center computer.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll bring 'em by tomorrow morning. Need me to help set up too?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, let's check the shed first. I've got a signup list in my garage if we need more.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, let's grab my tools from the shed first, then we can swing by your garage for that signup list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds like a plan. I'll grab my tool belt too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Tess, I heard we're organizing a repair drive next Saturday. Do you have the details?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, Eli! It's next Saturday at the community center, starting at 9 AM. Everyone's supposed to bring tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, 9 AM sharp. I'll bring my old tool kit and be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Mina, the repair drive is happening Sunday at the community center. I'm so glad you're checking in!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So it really is for the community center computer? That thing's been crashing all month.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's the one! We're hoping to get it running smoothly again. Could you spread the word?
